contentPattern.structure: text column (heading + paragraph + disclaimer) | single image column, on a cream card background

suitableFor: two-column explanatory/comparison sections pairing text with a supporting image
'how is X different from Y' informational panels on a tinted card background
notSuitableFor: text/link-list teaser layouts with overlay CTA (use columns-links)
dark alternating image/content promo rows (use columns-promo)
before/after result galleries with BEFORE/AFTER labels (use columns-result)
